messages:
tariq: quick follow-up from the postmortem \u2014 want to lock owners and concrete, short timelines for the GPU/autoscale remediation items. i'm proposing a lightweight tracker + a recurring 30m sync to move things along.

maya: i'll take scheduler tuning end-to-end. goal: baseline in 4 business days, implement conservative changes in 10 days, validate under synthetic load by day 14. will collaborate with eng-infra for test harness. :muscle:

anita: i'll own quota and procurement. plan: open cloud quota ticket and vendor uplift requests today, estimate response windows, and surface any spend approvals needed. target: vendor/cloud outreach complete in 3 business days.

sam: i'll draft the surge runbook and temporary mitigation playbook. propose phases: throttle low-priority routes, spin burst pool, progressive traffic shed. first draft by day 7, tabletop dry-run at next sync.

opsbot: created task REM-2109, calendar event "GPU Autoscale Remediation" (Wednesdays 9:30am PT), reminder 24h before.

metrics-bot: alert summary: peak GPU utilization 98% during incident; sustained p99 request queueing spike. saved snapshot to s3://redwood-incidents/gpu/2069999999/snapshot.json

```
Action checklist (please confirm owners/dates):
- QUOTA & PROCUREMENT: owner=anita, due=+3d, steps=[open tickets, estimate lead-time, cost approval]
- SCHEDULER TUNING: owner=maya, due=+14d, steps=[perf baseline, conservative tunables, validate under 60%+ load]
- SURGE RUNBOOK: owner=sam, due=+7d, steps=[runbook draft, tabletop, automation hooks]
- DASHBOARDS & ALERTS: owner=tariq, due=+2d, steps=[headroom gauges, surge alerting]
```

tariq: tagging infra/sre for visibility. if anyone needs additional headroom for testing (dev clusters or reserved ephemeral GPUs) say here and i'll arrange.

maya: quick config i want to A/B test: reduce batch size and lower preemption threshold. sample diff below: 

```yaml
# test config for scheduler A/B
batch_settings:
  max_batch_tokens: 1024  # current 2048
  prefer_smaller_batches: true
preemption:
  enabled: true
  threshold: 0.25  # lower from 0.5
```

anita: noted. i'll capture any quota pricing delta and loop in finance. if vendor requires minimum commit we'll surface alternatives (short-term burst vs reserved).

sam: runbook will include clear rollback steps and an escalation ladder (on-call -> infra lead -> eng manager). also adding checklist for canary validation (latency SLA, error budget consumption).

opsbot: REM-2109 updated: subtasks created for each owner. next sync event created with agenda template.

tariq: thanks all. please update the tracker with any blockers. plan: first sync this Wednesday to review baselines and vendor responses.

maya: will upload baseline numbers by EOD +4.

anita: opening tickets now and posting links in tracker.

sam: drafting runbook outline now, will include tabletop script.

metrics-bot: headroom estimate for next 72h with current patterns: 6% free GPUs across production clusters. recommend enabling burst pool policy before high-risk days.

tariq: copy. if approvals needed i'll escalate in leadership thread. cheers.
